## Void Deck 1.2.1

**The Home screen moves.** The dot field behind the featured game is alive now: a slanted band of brighter dots sweeps
across it from right to left, while single dots flick on and off at their own pace, like a signal catching. It stays
behind the artwork and out of the way — a glitch you notice in passing, not a light show. If your system asks for
reduced motion, the effect turns itself off.

**Updates install cleanly now.** GitHub reports checksums with a `sha256:` prefix that Decky's installer does not
expect, so an update could download and then be rejected at the last step. The panel now hands Decky the bare digest,
and skips the check instead of failing when a release publishes no checksum.

**No more phantom updates.** After a successful install the row switches to **Update installed — restart Steam to
finish**, so the same version is never offered twice.

**Install / update:** Decky → ⚙ → Developer → *Install Plugin from ZIP*, then select `VoidDeck-v1.2.1.zip` from this release.
